Ubiquity networks makes an access point (WiFi) that has a setting where you can reduce the signal strength. OpenWRT and DD WRT are open source firmware updates. Think of it as a new operating system for your WiFi router. You have to have compatible hardware of course, but the list is fairly extensive. I believe both of them allow for adjusting signal strength.
